is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.s. (Page 1, Title and Abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study investigates the kdr L1014F (Vgsc L995F) mutation (Page 2, 'Methods' and Page 3, 'Mosquitoes').

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype counts or frequencies from field populations are reported; only the behavior of pre-determined laboratory strains (Kisumu, kdr-kis, and their RS cross) is analyzed.

african_field_population.evidence: The study only uses laboratory reference strains (Kisumu and kdr-kis) and does not test any field-collected mosquitoes (Page 3, 'Mosquitoes' section).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study investigating the influence of pyrethroid-treated nets on host-seeking behavior.

sub_country_location.evidence: Not applicable as no field collections were conducted.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Not applicable as no field collections were conducted.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Not applicable as this is a laboratory-based behavioral study.

supplement.evidence: No supplementary files are needed because the study is fundamentally ineligible due to the lack of field-collected mosquitoes.

assessment.summary: This study investigates the host-seeking behavior of Anopheles gambiae s.s. in response to permethrin-treated nets using laboratory reference strains (Kisumu and kdr-kis) in a dual-choice olfactometer. Because the study relies entirely on laboratory colonies and does not test field-collected mosquito populations, it does not meet the eligibility criteria.
